reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the agent that prepared the corrections; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of 246 method-type corrections proposed from docs/reviews/use-cases/baselines-2026-10-12.md and their two new sources. Every previous value was compared with origin/main and the store, every edit matched to the baseline review or a documented source check, and the cited source re-retrieved and read for 97 edits across 21 sources. 245 are approved and applied; CPPC row 23 is withdrawn. 26 claims were corrected and a source record for CPPC Note S1 was added. Details are in docs/reviews/2026-10-12-method-type-corrections.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any tool.
148 edits were checked against the store and record descriptions only, not against their publication.
The CPPC tags rest on the authors' reimplementation in Note S1; the original submission write-ups were not read.
The Benelli 2012 hash is of rendered page text, and the LSHVec preprint hash cannot be reproduced by re-downloading (bioRxiv stamps each download).
